blocks.title: A product that has traits

runs.text: Every product has an offer and an expiry: if it is not on offer, its offer is 0 %, and if it does not expire soon, its date is far away. A product that expires in two days or less sells at half price. The yoghurt has both traits: first the offer lowers it from 40 to 30, and then the expiry leaves it at 15.
A product has, or not, each trait, and its final price applies the ones it has
A third trait, such as the deposit bottle, adds a class and an attribute, not four new particular cases.

points.text: Inheriting creates a class that is a particular case of another and can override its methods.
Composing is building an object from other objects it holds inside.
